title: What It Actually Looks Like to Work Hard Without Making Work Your God
caption:
There's a difference between working because you were built for it and working because you need it to prove something. One is worship. The other is exhausting.

Full speed for six days is discipline. Still checking email on the seventh is a man who doesn't trust anyone to run the world without him for a day. If a slow month makes you feel worthless, work was never just work. It was where you were getting your name from, and your name was given before your first paycheck.

The goal isn't the guy who never stops. It's the guy who can stop, because he actually believes God's holding what he built while he sleeps.
